title: Flagged translation passage outcomes
description: The answers a human reviewer may give on a passage the translation workflow's QA flagged.

source.note: bean bvuk; owner approved the answer set 2026-09-23

codes.label: Accept as is
codes.definition: The translation is acceptable as written (the flag was a false positive); the workflow writes an unofficial status.

codes.label: Re-translate
codes.definition: The passage is edited, or rejected and requested again; either way it goes back through translation and QA runs again.
